description:
The three largest countries in Jungmun are Haeseo, Ogyeon, and Byeorae. Among them, Byeorae was a country founded by the ancient god (shinseon), and it's said that Byeorae country will not perish as long as the three treasures of the gods are in Byeorae. Even though it was a powerful country, but now it has become a small and powerless country. The king of Haeseo became a conqueror and gradually became stronger. The ambitious king now not only wants to expand agriculture and organize/coordinate the nation's power, but he also wants to conquer the heart of Byeorae's crown prince. Song of flowers and rain…

 *Note: Chapter count includes four side story chapters.*
